entries.name: supabase_admin:public:tables
entries.reason: Supabase platform default for objects supabase_admin creates in public. The migration role (postgres) is not a member of supabase_admin and cannot alter its default privileges. Our migrations never create objects as supabase_admin, and any object that did would still fail the relation_grant rule.
